shape.mapping: both Gym interfaces expose port/starboard; the frozen serialized action appends steer_0=0 and steer_1=0

sign_convention.differential_probe: [+0.25, -0.25] produces positive NED yaw in HoloOcean, matching bcod-sim's port-minus-starboard positive-yaw convention

actuator_dynamics.bcod_sim_vehicle_a: first-order motor lag, time constant 0.25 s
actuator_dynamics.holoocean_wrapper: exact bcod-sim exponential first-order update at each 0.05 s physics tick, time constant 0.25 s

conclusion: The policy-facing normalized actions, port/starboard mapping, sign convention, force scale, and per-physics-tick actuator lag now match bcod-sim Vehicle A. The frozen four-field serialization is represented by appending two mandatory zero steering fields.
